details:
Project Title: AYO-X: Alexandria Precipitation Trend Analysis (2010–2025)

Project Summary:

AYO-X addresses the challenge of extracting meaningful insights from complex Earth observation data by analyzing 15 years of monthly precipitation trends along Egypt's northern coast (Alexandria). By transforming raw satellite datasets (NASA GPM IMERG) into a clean, reproducible Python workflow, the project uncovers seasonal variability and extreme precipitation patterns.

Value & Impact:

This work provides scientists, researchers, and urban planners with a ready-to-use analytical foundation, saving significant time and effort in local climate research.

Future Roadmap:

The next phase focuses on scaling this pipeline into an interactive web-based analytics tool capable of evaluating multiple regions, identifying clear climate trends, and conducting advanced scientific research to correlate these precipitation shifts with drought and flood events.
